platforms: ONE store H5 iframe, actual store HTML transformation/variants and mocked host SDK

browser.timing: Single unthrottled serial samples per platform/phase, fresh browser per phase. Frontend baseline uses prior Git HTML/JS/assets with same isolated candidate API. Direct forge first includes fixed 350ms settling after row selection; entry suite measures selected row/detail. Lobby launch includes network-idle settling. These are local view readiness measurements, not physical-device or production-network latency.

browser.cleanup: Fusion destroyed, controller aborted, audio destroyed, active own GSAP tweens 0, remaining fusion canvases 0, post-exit fusion requests 0 in both entry visits.
browser.recovery: PC 1000 committed results recovered on reopening after simulated lost response, GET only with no additional POST.
